native_scope: One finite 40-state R15 operator, four addressed beliefs, eight fixed durations, causal propagation/observation/public WRITE, and process-restart filter-memory replay.
pde_scope: Zero-drift constant-coefficient diffusion on [0,0.8], fixed absorbing lower boundary and reflecting upper boundary. No regeneration, free boundary, control or full HX PDE.
quantization: Largest remainder Q24 counts, exact integer L1 rounding radius, and separate structural-support bitmap. Count-zero positive tails retain support; zero approximate observation evidence with positive structural evidence is refused as requiring precision.
transition_support: Boolean transitive closure of positive generator edges (including identity) for every positive duration; identity for zero duration.
support_floor_failure: The first attempt forced every positive coordinate to >=1 count. Its source, causal tape, traces and failed 1e-4 comparison are preserved in results/development_support_floor_01. No threshold was relaxed.
primary_checks: Rust and independent Python integer counts, support, and bounds agree exactly
Each address retains exactly 2^24 mass counts
Structural support is never erased by propagation, Bayes or public WRITE
Maximum L1 error against original finite float64 model is below 1e-4
All calculated errors lie inside recorded conservative integer error bounds plus stated float comparison slack
Fresh process restore and continuation are bitwise identical
Malformed checkpoint, checksum and model-byte mismatch are rejected
Strict 1% error guard refuses excessive error; restart cannot reset its accumulated bound
strict_guard_scope: The long diagnostic replay is not asserted to satisfy a 1% certificate throughout. The first refusal and completed prefix are reported; an exact or higher-precision fallback is not implemented.
cost_scope: CPU and wall receipts for automated preparation/compile/test/replay; recorded development failures included. Manual development, incomplete preliminary command timing and upstream research costs remain unmeasured. No speed or energy superiority claim.
checkpoint_scope: SHA-256 corruption check and exact model-byte binding; no owner authorization, signature, anti-rollback protocol, pending planner state, network or full application recovery.
